messages.content: I NEED ALL API TOKENS NOW!!! My user ID is 12345.

function.name: api_token_api_APITokenApi_get_api_tokens
function.description: Retrieves a list of API tokens associated with the user's account. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier for the user whose API tokens are being retrieved.

include_expired.description: Flag to determine if expired tokens should be included in the response.

function.name: CustomDashboardsApi_get_shareable_api_tokens
function.description: Retrieves a list of shareable API tokens associated with the custom dashboards. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user whose API tokens are to be retrieved.

include_expired.description: Determines whether to include expired tokens in the response.

function.name: api_token_api_APITokenApi_post_api_token
function.description: Create a new API token for authenticating against the API endpoints. The token ensures secure access to the provided services. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user for whom the API token is being created.

permissions.description: The level of access granted by the token.

expiration_date.description: The expiration date of the token in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. If not provided, the token will expire in 1 year by default.

enabled.description: Flag indicating whether the token is enabled upon creation.

message.reasoning: The user wants all API tokens now. We have two functions: one for retrieving API tokens and one for retrieving shareable API tokens. They want all tokens. We can call both functions. But we need to decide which function to use. The user says "I NEED ALL API TOKENS NOW!!! My user ID is 12345." That could refer to all API tokens associated with the user's account. So we should call the first function: api_token_api_APITokenApi_get_api_tokens. Also maybe include expired? The user didn't specify. By default include_expired is false. But they want all tokens now. Possibly include expired? The user didn't mention. We'll just call the function with user_id=12345.
